claim_boundary.primary: MV-HGS-SP is a three-view portfolio that retains the best independently feasible complete-model incumbent.
claim_boundary.secondary: A checked time-limited MIP route-pool recombination may improve that incumbent and its frequency and magnitude must be reported descriptively.
claim_boundary.forbidden: Do not claim stable or material route-level 1+1+1>3 superadditivity.
claim_boundary.compute: Do not claim equal time or equal compute against a single view; report the extra three-view and MIP work.

route_fusion_reporting_only: Record strict route-fusion wins and mean incremental reduction but do not use them as a pass criterion and do not elevate them into a stable-mechanism claim.
failure_rule: Reject unchanged if any registered invariant, win-count, mean-reduction, search-improvement, or trajectory threshold is missed. Do not change the claim, panel, seed, algorithm, budget, MIP cap, or thresholds after results. Do not rerun failed pairs.
authorization_on_pass: Freeze this algorithm and claim boundary for the complete corrected E2 rerun. Passing confirmation is not itself formal paper evidence.
